_: Sheets knowingly installed outside a WAIVABLE gate check, with the reason.
As of 2026-08-04 exactly one check is waivable: facing separation, for a
sheet whose eight facings are genuinely unusual. Everything else in
tools/verify_art_batch.mjs is structural — wrong dimensions, a file that
will not decode, an empty cell, a baked matte, missing or stale content —
and structural failures are never waivable.
The aesthetic bands this file used to waive (body contrast, accent spread,
body saturation) were RETIRED, not waived. Waiving the same three checks on
every character in the roster is not a gate. See docs/SPRITES.md,
A stale entry is a failure: tools/sim_test.mjs asserts every id listed here
genuinely fails something, so an exception cannot outlive the problem.
